scope: Independent still-image review of all six contact sheets (87 downsampled frames), plus four original 720x720 Walk frames. No editor execution by this reviewer.

findings.detail: All 29 subjects appear contained and rendered in the sampled poses. Bat, segmented wurm, scorpions, quadrupeds, low slime, plant, skeleton and construct families have visibly different silhouettes; no missing body or detached geometry was apparent in these stills.
The actual SkeletalSentry helmet sits on the skull with eye sockets and ribs visible in the full-resolution Walk frame. This is a single item/pose view, not an all-angle armor fit claim.

Endemic frog and lizard markings remain distinct: Reedfrog green spots, Bandfrog red bars, GinFrog pale plain face, SummitSinger dark head mark; SunStriker stripes, Brocchinia dorsal spots and PrickleBrowGecko paired horns/pale dorsal markers. The full-resolution Bandfrog and PrickleBrowGecko frames contain no apparent repaired coplanar face speckles.

CaveBear, JungleStalker, ObsidianBrute, CharredHusk and Bandfrog have low interior contrast against the dark green ground. Eyes, accents and silhouettes remain legible in these close-up captures; normal camera distance and motion readability are not established by this gallery.

verdict: No new blocking geometry or fit defect found in this bounded still-image review. This is not broad visual/gameplay acceptance.
limits: Only four originals were viewed at full resolution; the other 83 frames were viewed as contact-sheet thumbnails.
Gallery poses use authored art fixtures and changing cameras. These stills do not prove continuous animation quality, gameplay attack attribution, actual combat, or acquisition.
No claims about all angles, lighting conditions, normal-camera-scale readability, performance, clipping during full animation, or exact style test results beyond the linked native receipt.
